verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־ אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- hag·git·tîṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nê·nū māh- ’ad·dîr šim·k̲ā bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer tə·nāh hō·wḏ·ḵā ‘al- haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Gittith A Psalm of David O LORD our Lord how majestic is Your name in all the earth You have set Your glory above the heavens

verses.original: מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pî ‘ō·wl·lîm wə·yō·nə·qîm yis·saḏ·tā ‘ōz lə·ma·‘an ṣō·wr·re·ḵā lə·haš·bîṯ ’ō·w·yêḇ ū·miṯ·naq·qêm
verses.literal: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries to silence the enemy and avenger

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’er·’eh šā·mê·k̲ā ma·‘ă·śê ’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯe·ḵā yā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’ă·šer kō·w·nā·nə·tāh
verses.literal: When I behold Your heavens the work of Your fingers the moon and the stars which You have set in place

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ĕ·nō·wōš kî- ṯiz·kə·ren·nū ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām kî ṯip̄·qə·ḏen·nū
verses.literal: what is man that You are mindful of him or the son of man that You care for him

verses.original: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḥas·sə·rê·hū mə·‘aṭ mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār tə·‘aṭ·ṭə·rê·hū
verses.literal: You made him a little lower . . . than the angels You crowned him with glory and honor

verses.original: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־ רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: tam·šî·lê·hū bə·ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏe·ḵā kōl šat·tāh ṯa·ḥaṯ- raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands You have placed everything under his feet

verses.original: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·neh wa·’ă·lā·p̄îm kul·lām wə·ḡam ba·hă·mō·wṯ śā·ḏāy
verses.literal: all sheep and oxen and even the beasts of the field

verses.original: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea all that swim the paths of the seas

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָֽה־ אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: O LORD our Lord how majestic is Your name in all the earth
